cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a walled garden with a lotus pond — standing; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — kneeling on the ground; a Peking opera dressing room — standing; A window table in a riverside antique shop with stacked paint boxes — She pairs old enamel color chips with a hand-painted toy boat; A quiet contemporary cabin on a moored heritage ship — She inspects the polished lacquer on a restored wooden miniature of a river junk; a Roman marble bath hall — standing; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a photo studio with a seamless paper backdrop sweeping onto the floor — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a foley recording booth with microphones and boxes of noisy props — carries an acoustic guitar by its neck at her side; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — perched on a ledge or edge; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — seated on a chair; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — carries her keepsake low at her side; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — rests the pen from a notebook against her lips
